body:
TLDR: get rid of section "V13.4 Build and Deploy", as it causes confusion with our scope definitions (that do not include build and deploy steps).

edit 2025-04-24 updating numbers, as previous 13.4.4 is now removed.

* 13.4.1 / v5.0.be-14.1.10 - move to v1 ~~V13.3 Secret Management~~ / v2 ~~be together with V13.2.3 (for both "V13.2" does not feel a perfect match)~~ / v3: goes to V6.3
* 13.4.2 / v5.0.be-14.1.11 - move to V13.5 Unintended Information Leakage
* 13.4.3 / v5.0.be-14.1.9 (#1438), 13.4.5 / v5.0.be-14.1.7 and part of 13.4.4 / v5.0.be-14.1.6 - change the point of view and move to V15.2
  * point of view: application does not expose functionality in production, that is not required for the application to work, such as test code, development functionality.
  * why 15.2 - did not find anything more suitable and - there is no dependency for this functionality and should be removed because of that
  * level 2 - 13.4.3 is at the moment L2 and 13.4.5 is L3. Merge proposal does not ask clearly, that production environment does not include test-code, but it is not exposed - if we agree with that, it can be L2. If not, we probably can not merge. Can also use "L2 do not expose, L3 do not contain".
* 13.4.4 / v5.0.be-14.1.6 (#2998)
  * unneeded features - will be covered by 13.4.3+13.4.5 proposal
  * documentation - to discuss, merge to 13.5.4 or 13.5.5
  * sample applications - will be covered by 13.4.3+13.4.5 proposal
  * configurations - to discuss, merge to 13.5.4 or 13.5.5
  * and file or directory metadata (such as Thumbs.db, .DS_Store) are removed. - to discuss, merge to 13.5.4 or 13.5.5, or to just remove/ignore

This issue is only for discussing the concept. If agreed, the wording and/or location for each requirement will be discussed separately.

**V13.4 Build and Deploy** requirements at the moment

| # | Description | Level | #v5.0.be |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **13.4.1** | Verify that default user accounts (e.g., "root", "admin", or "sa") are not present in the application or are disabled. | 1 | v5.0.be-14.1.10 |
| **13.4.2** | Verify that the application is deployed either without any source control metadata, including the .git or .svn folders, or in a way that these folders are inaccessible both externally and to the application itself. | 1 | v5.0.be-14.1.11 |
| **13.4.3** | Verify that application code or functionality can only be changed via the standard update or build process and not directly in production through application functionality or some other direct modification mechanism. | 2 | v5.0.be-14.1.9 |
| **13.4.4** | Verify that all unneeded features, documentation, sample applications, configurations, and file or directory metadata (such as Thumbs.db, .DS_Store) are removed. | 3 | v5.0.be-14.1.6 |
| **13.4.5** | Verify that production environment does not include test code. | 3 | v5.0.be-14.1.7 |

Related and referenced requirements from **V13.5 Unintended Information Leakage**

| # | Description | Level | #v5.0.be |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **13.5.4** | Verify that the application does not expose detailed version information of server-side components. | 3 | v5.0.be-14.3.3 |
| **13.5.5** | Verify that the web tier is configured to serve only files with specific file extensions to prevent unintentional information, configuration, and source code leakage. | 3 | v5.0.be-14.3.5 |

ping @tghosth @jmanico @randomstuff

comments.body:
I have not read all the details of this post and I will later today, but I really like this direction. 

We want to get away from build and deploy type requirements (per my understanding of the current ASVS philosophy). This is a good way to do it.

I read your suggestion more carefully and think this is a very good direction. I 100% support you charging forward with this move. This is one of the biggest areas where ASVS is out of scope and your suggestion addresses it perfectly without sacrificing existing work.

Discussed with Elar, we propose the following for now:

- Need to be clearer in 13.2 section text that this also applies to local/OS services as well as remote.
- Move 13.4.1 to 6.3.2
- Move 13.4.2 to 13.5

@elarlang to prepare a proposal for how to handle 13.4.3-13.4.5, either here or in a separate issue

Based on the numbers used in the issue description:
* 13.4.1 is moved to 6.3.2
* 13.4.2 is now 13.4.1 and is in correct place (if to move it to V13.5 and then remove section V13.4, it is again with number 13.4.1)
* 13.4.3 + 13.4.5 merge proposal is in https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1438#issuecomment-2828236219
* 13.4.4 split and coverage is discussed in https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2998#issuecomment-2828299274

title: Proposal to move requirements away from "V13.4 Build and Deploy"
